text: Standard engagement letter, version 3, current. Either party may cancel this engagement by giving 30 days written notice. Fees are billed monthly in arrears. Scope changes require a signed amendment before work begins. This version supersedes version 2.

Standard engagement letter, version 2, superseded. Either party may cancel this engagement by giving 60 days written notice. Fees are billed quarterly in advance. Scope changes may be agreed verbally and confirmed later.

Approved proposal language. Describe the client outcome before the method. Do not name a client in a case study without written consent. Every claim about savings must cite the engagement it came from. Avoid superlatives that cannot be evidenced.

Independence policy. A partner may not hold securities in an audit client. Conflicts must be cleared before a proposal is submitted. The independence team maintains the restricted entity list and reviews it weekly.

Certifications held. ISO 27001 for information security, renewed each March. SOC 2 Type II covering security and availability. Attestation reports are available to clients under a mutual confidentiality agreement.

Pricing framework, restricted. Blended rates start at 180 units per hour for advisory work. Discounts beyond 15 percent require regional approval. Fixed-fee engagements carry a 12 percent contingency.
Partner compensation, restricted. Level 5 partners receive a base allocation of 420 units plus a performance share. Allocations are set by the compensation committee and are not disclosed outside it.
